newsitem.title: UK: BAe,Vickers to announce marketing deal - paper.
newsitem.headline: BAe,Vickers to announce marketing deal - paper.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc and Vickers are close to sealing a deal under which BAe will market Vickers tanks and other armoured vehicles in some regions, a British newspaper said on Sunday.
The Sunday Times said that among the most likely markets where the cooperation could pay off was Qatar, which plans to buy some 500 million sterling ($800 million) in British defence equipment.
It also said Saudi Arabia could be an important market. Vickers, with its Challenger 2 tank, is currently vying with France's Le Clerc for an 800 million sterling ($1.3 billion) order.
It quoted a BAe spokesman as saying that discussions with Vickers were taking place on a marketing link-up.
"This would be consistent with our prime contracting role in defence export orders," the spokesman said.
The report said the deal appeared to end the hopes of GKN, Britain's other main armoured vehicle producer, for an alliance with Vickers.
BAe and U.S. aircraft maker Lockheed Martin Corp said on Thursday they would bid for a new U.S. and British army scout car and reconnaissance vehicle.
It said Vickers and U.S. group General Dynamics Land Systems would also join the development team.
